response.overview: Nizam deeply loves his wife and son. The family lives in harmony and luxury. Whatever Yana desires, Nizam will fulfill. However, life is not always perfect. The factory where he works closes due to economic hardship. Nizam hides this from his family. He works hard and continues to fulfill Yana's requests. Their marriage begins to falter when Yana encounters her former lover. Farouk pampers Yana with luxury and gives her much attention. Farouk also wants Yana to ask her husband for a divorce and start a new life with him. Will Yana be willing to betray her marriage with Nizam?
response.title: Bawa Aku Ke Syurga
